response: Oncoplastic surgery is not a contraindication for accelerated partial breast radiation using the interstitial multicatheter brachytherapy method. In fact, preliminary results suggest that this method can be feasible for selected low-risk breast cancer patients who have undergone oncoplastic breast-conserving surgery. However, it is essential to pay special attention to target volume definition. Further prospective investigations with long-term follow-up are necessary to determine the true value and efficacy of this procedure.
